title: feat: wp11 list-keys with RFC 7512 PKCS#11 URI output
description: OpenSSL, curl, nginx, and most PKCS#11-aware tools reference keys by RFC 7512 URI (e.g. pkcs11:token=YubiKey%205%20NFC;id=%01;type=private). wolfP11 has no command that tells a user what URI to use for a discovered key, making the library hard to wire into existing toolchains without trial and error. This epic adds a wp11 list-keys [slot] subcommand that enumerates key objects and emits a well-formed, percent-encoded PKCS#11 URI for each — copy-pasteable directly into openssl dgst -sign, curl --key, and nginx ssl_certificate_key directives.
